entities.summary: Victoria Nkong is a Nigerian multilingual entertainment consultant and an event producer. She worked as a bi-lingual presenter, producer for Kora Awards, Headies Awards and she is currently the associate producer for AFRIMA AWARDS; she helped found a charity called the Life Fountain Orphanage Home. Victoria is the Executive Producer of Cruise & Chills boat cruise networking party for Business Moguls, Media and Celebrities: She is also behind Slum Invasion annual charity event. In 2017, Victoria was featured on "Women Rock Project".
